notes.title: Mouse Controls Patch
notes.notes:
Now you can use the mouse to attack!

Controls list:
Basic attack - left click
Heavy attack - middle mouse button
Parry - right click

Thank you shep for the patch suggestion :)

notes.title: INARI's Big Release!
notes.notes:
INARI is available for download TODAY

Starting now, INARI is available for free to download. Big thanks to everyone who supported and wishlisted the game. We hope that everyone enjoys the new content - good luck to those who try to get every achievement!

Daisuke even baked a cake for everyone, how sweet :)
